title: game/objectives/<id>.json
description: One objective of the session (CONTENT_PLAN 3.5, C07). Loaded by ObjectiveBook (Vocaterra.Game.Core). A checklist has a title and its steps name nouns; another objective is shown by its objective.<id>.hud line.

event.description: The event waited for: a world event (WorldEvents), or for a tip start or aimed_npc.

npc.description: The NPC the event must be about (an agent id).

detail.description: The detail the event must have, exactly (item_picked_up: the noun; torch_at_ring: the ring's name).

trigger.description: What the step or tip waits for (CONTENT_PLAN C06).

id.description: The objective's id, the file's name.

title.description: The target-language title of a checklist (Campamento).

id.description: The step's id; the save keys it <objective>.<step>.

noun.description: For a checklist step: the catalogue noun it is about.

label.description: The word the checklist shows, when the noun's lemma or plural is not it.

restore.description: The code hook that works the step out again from a loaded world; the save does not keep the step.

alsoDoneBy.description: The objectives whose progress also completes this one.

onComplete.description: The code hooks run when the objective is completed.
